title: Faraday finds that magnetic fields change the polarization of light

tellings.quote: he did experiments he found that magnetic fields Chang the polarization of lights

plain: A biologist and writer named Rupert Sheldrake, talking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls the 19th-century scientist Michael Faraday. Sheldrake says that Faraday did experiments showing that magnetic fields change the polarization of light, meaning the direction in which light waves vibrate. He brings it up as an example of how forces once thought separate turned out to be linked.
